# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi

"""Publish the closed original bench.sh phase-OFF control and method policy."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import shutil
import statistics

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W = G / '.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'
WF = G / '.worktree/feat-fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013'
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-phase-off-control'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_off_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def hashes(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: hashes(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [hashes(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(hashes(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')


def archive(path, target):
    dump(target, dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text()))


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-phase-cache-stock-off-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True,
        commands=[], evidence={}, gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False)

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = load(B / 'main-phase-cache-serial-gate-build-root-v6/record.json')['environment']

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        print('OWNED STOCK OFF PUBLICATION ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
            rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=4 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '0f1127823e6c77f324093d9ffcf42cb773ce8ced'
        assert not run('status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        lp = B / 'main-phase-cache-stock-off-launch-root-v1/record.json'
        launch = load(lp)
        assert launch['passed'] and launch['complete'] and not launch['active']
        assert launch['phase_cache'] == launch['copy_engine'] == 0 and launch['stock_long_comparison_eligible']
        assert not launch['quality_evaluated'] and not launch['adopted']
        assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in launch['commands'])
        for item in (launch['supervisor_result'], launch['upstream_result'], launch['source_closure'], launch['main_config']):
            assert m.sha(item['path']) == item['sha256']
        sp = Path(launch['supervisor_result']['path'])
        supervisor = load(sp)
        assert supervisor['passed'] and supervisor['complete'] and not supervisor['active']
        assert all(c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in supervisor['commands'])
        assert supervisor['normal_quit']['normal_quit'] and not supervisor['normal_quit']['fallback_signals']
        assert all(not v['faults'] for k, v in supervisor.items() if k.startswith('kernel-'))
        samples = launch['result_assessment']['samples']
        assert len(samples) == 3
        assert all(s['prompt_tokens'] == s['read_tokens'] == 32049 and s['reused_tokens'] == 0 and s['generated_tokens'] == 24 for s in samples)
        source = load(launch['source_closure']['path'])
        assert all(m.sha(path) == digest for path, digest in source['source_pins'].items())
        F.mkdir()
        originals = {str(path): m.sha(path) for path in (lp, sp, Path(launch['upstream_result']['path']))}
        dump(F / 'receipts/launch.json', launch)
        dump(F / 'receipts/supervisor.json', supervisor)
        for name in ('main-config.json', 'server-quiet.json', 'closed-source-config-review.json'):
            archive(lp.parent / name, F / 'configuration' / (name + '.json'))
        result = Path(launch['upstream_result']['path'])
        target = F / 'upstream/results.json'
        target.parent.mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(result, target)
        assert m.sha(target) == m.sha(result) and not load(target)['results']['failures']
        archive(result.parent / 'README.md', F / 'upstream/README.md.json')
        for name in ('main-phase-cache-stock-bench-launch-v1.py', 'main-phase-cache-stock-off-publication-v1.py'):
            archive(B / name, F / 'controllers' / (name + '.json'))
        P = B / 'main-upstream-benchsh-supervisor-source-v3'
        for path in sorted(P.glob('*.py.txt')):
            archive(path, F / 'supervisor-source' / (path.name + '.json'))
        engine = sp.parent / 'engine.log'
        rows = engine.read_text().splitlines()
        retained = [row for row in rows if re.search(r'INFO|READY|phase-cache|native|cache|pool|kv|GPU|WARNING|ERROR|FATAL|SYCL', row, re.I)]
        dump(F / 'engine-evidence.json', dict(path=str(engine), bytes=engine.stat().st_size,
            sha256=m.sha(engine), retained_lines=retained, extraction='Configuration, runtime path and fault summaries; successful repetitions retired'))
        stdout = sp.parent / 'bench.stdout'
        archive(stdout, F / 'official-console.json')
        reports = ['research-prefill-total-live-owner-bytes-round376-v1.txt',
            'research-prefill-total-live-owner-bytes-round376-v2.txt',
            'research-phase-supplemental-hash-consumers-round377-v1.txt',
            'research-stock-bench-longer-cases-round378-v1.txt',
            'research-full-context-probe-primary-state-semantics-round379-v1.txt']
        report_pins = []
        for name in reports:
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            archive(B / 'research-20261009' / name, target)
            report_pins.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        previous = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-phase-cache-model-lifetime/report-registry-v188.json'
        assert load(previous)['research_completed'] == 917
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v189.json', dict(research_completed=922,
            prior=dict(path=str(previous), git_revision='0f1127823e6c77f324093d9ffcf42cb773ce8ced', sha256=m.sha(previous)),
            new_reports=report_pins, main_only_test_execution=True))
        def stats(key):
            values = [s[key] for s in samples]
            return dict(samples=values, median=statistics.median(values), minimum=min(values), maximum=max(values))
        summary = dict(main_reviewed=True, source_revision=launch['source_revision'],
            upstream_revision=launch['upstream_revision'], benchmark_method='Unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs3',
            copy_engine=0, phase_cache=0, samples=samples, prefill=stats('prompt_tps'), decode=stats('decode_tps'),
            actual_prompt_tokens=32049, actual_generated_tokens=24, stock_long_comparison_eligible=True,
            strict32768_performance_eligible=False, all_official_requests_succeeded=True,
            no_fresh_gpu_faults=True, prepost_identities_unchanged=True, normal_quit=True,
            optimization_adopted=False, quality_evaluated=False, full_physical262144_qualified=False,
            phase_on_measured=False, research_registry_count=922,
            main_errata=['R376v1 mode0 assumption was wrong for actual phase lifetime. v2 mode1 host-authoritative full262144/resident32768 is authoritative.',
                'Mode1 int8 stage is276825088 requested bytes; identity table262144 bytes is outside bytes_needed. Both are chunk-independent.',
                'Total bytes_needed 8K-to16K delta2455109632 bytes remains valid under the stated branches; actual init also adds32768 token-buffer bytes. Physical fit is still unqualified.',
                'Model v3 scope says two outputs each; max_new2 is a cap, actual1024 request returned valid EOS1 and32768 returned2. Original receipt stays unchanged.',
                'R378 proposes a future client parameter extension only; current client and32K/24 caps stay unchanged.'],
            next_step='Same binary/config/client quiet phase ON in a separate owned process; compare prefill and decode independently; qualify quality/full256K separately')
        dump(F / 'summary.json', summary)
        table = '\n'.join(f'| {i+1} | {s["prompt_tokens"]} | {s["generated_tokens"]} | {s["prompt_tps"]:.1f} | {s["decode_tps"]:.1f} |' for i,s in enumerate(samples))
        ja = f'''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# 上流 bench.sh による phase OFF 基準

Arc B570 / Ryzen 5600X、free、source-built DPC++ 7.1.1、native IQ3_S で、
変更していない上流 v0.1.43 の bench.sh --long --runs 3 を実行しました。
engine source は 0f112782、phase cache と native COPY は OFF、chunk 8192、
group 16、workers 5、tasks 18、no borrow/MTP/reuse、int8 KV resident 32768、
context 262144 です。trace と validation は性能測定中に無効です。

| Run | 実入力/read | 出力 | Prefill tok/s | Decode tok/s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
{table}

各入力は 32049、再利用 0、出力 24 でした。prefill 中央値は
{summary['prefill']['median']:.1f} tok/s、decode 中央値は {summary['decode']['median']:.1f} tok/s です。
短い会話や複数ターンの結果は標準スイートの補助結果として残しています。
全リクエストが成功し、正常 QUIT、exit 0、所有 process の終了を確認しました。
測定前後の source、binary、model、provider が一致し、新しい GPU fault は
ありません。reset、サービス変更、再試行はしていません。

これは OFF 基準の一回の campaign です。ON 効果や採用を主張しません。
prefill と decode は別々に判定し、差が曖昧なら反復します。標準の約 32K
入力と 24 出力であり、全物理 256K、持続 decode、品質の認定ではありません。
生成文の完全一致を一般の品質条件にはしません。

並行調査 5 件を registry v189 に追加しました。R376 の誤った KV mode 0
前提は元報告と訂正版 v2 を両方保存し、Main の訂正を JSON に残しました。
KV は全 context 分の authoritative host buffer と resident GPU page cache
です。静的要求量と free telemetry を同一視しません。R377 の hash 診断省略、
R378 の測定長設定拡張、R379 の全 context 復元確認は source 調査だけです。
閉じた重複ログは hash と証拠を確認した削除 manifest に従って削除します。
'''
        en = f'''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Upstream bench.sh phase OFF control

Unchanged upstream v0.1.43 bench.sh --long --runs3 completed on Arc B570 /
Ryzen5600X, free/source-built DPC++7.1.1, native IQ3_S, source0f112782.
Phase cache and native COPY were OFF; chunk8192/group16, workers5/tasks18,
no borrow/MTP/reuse, int8 KV resident32768/context262144. Tracing and validation
were disabled during performance measurement.

| Run | Actual input/read | Output | Prefill tok/s | Decode tok/s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
{table}

Each row read32049 inputs with zero reuse and generated24 tokens. Prefill median
is {summary['prefill']['median']:.1f} tok/s and decode median is {summary['decode']['median']:.1f} tok/s.
Short chat and multi-turn results remain standard-suite supporting results.
All requests succeeded; original QUIT, exit0 and owned process closure passed.
Source/binary/model/provider identities matched before and after with no new
GPU fault, reset, service change or retry.

This is one OFF control campaign, not an ON effect or adoption claim. Assess
prefill and decode separately and repeat unclear effects. The stock approx32K
input/24-output case does not qualify full physical256K, sustained decode or
quality. Exact generated prose identity is not a universal quality condition.

Registry v189 adds5 research reports. R376's incorrect mode0 assumption is
preserved together with corrected v2 and Main's errata. Full-context host KV is
authoritative, with a bounded resident GPU page cache. Requested source sizes
are distinct from free-memory telemetry. R377 optional hash diagnostics, R378
longer benchmark settings and R379 full-context restore checks are source-only
research. Closed duplicate logs retire only under the verified deletion manifest.
'''
        (F / 'REPORT.ja.md').write_text(ja)
        (F / 'REPORT.md').write_text(en)
        for name in ('MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.ja.md','MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.md'):
            src=WF/'docs'/name
            assert not (W/'docs'/name).exists()
            shutil.copyfile(src,W/'docs'/name)
        ap = W / 'AGENTS.md'
        content = ap.read_text()
        anchor = 'Then run the existing tests the change can affect'
        assert content.count(anchor) == 1 and 'MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW' not in content
        content = content.replace(anchor,
            "For this workspace's performance comparisons, use upstream's unchanged `bench.sh` as\n"
            'described in [docs/MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.md](docs/MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.md). Keep native GEN and\n'
            'kernel/transfer fixtures for diagnostics; compare model speeds with the same upstream client.\n\n' + anchor)
        ap.write_text(content)
        raw_files = list(sp.parent.glob('*.stdout')) + list(sp.parent.glob('*.stderr')) + [engine]
        raw_files += list((lp.parent/'commands').glob('*.stdout')) + list((lp.parent/'commands').glob('*.stderr'))
        deletions = []
        for raw in sorted(set(raw_files)):
            if not raw.exists():continue
            if raw.name.startswith('kernel-') and raw.suffix == '.stdout' and raw.name != 'kernel-cursor.stdout':
                j=[json.loads(line) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines()]
                assert not supervisor[raw.stem]['faults']
            if raw.parent == lp.parent/'commands':
                assert raw.read_text() == launch['evidence'].get(raw.stem,dict(stdout=launch.get('stdout',''),stderr=launch.get('stderr','')))[raw.suffix[1:]]
            deletions.append(dict(path=str(raw),bytes=raw.stat().st_size,sha256=m.sha(raw),
                replacement='receipts/supervisor.json, official-console.json, engine-evidence.json and unchanged upstream/results.json',
                reason='Closed successful duplicate/API or repeated journal history; useful evidence preserved'))
        retention=dict(owner='Main',deletions=deletions,deleted=False,original_pinned_receipts_retained=True,
            active_runs_touched=False,free_space_claim=False,byte_budget=4<<20,
            consumer='Matching phase ON campaign and future correctness/fit qualification',
            next_review='After matched phase comparison or superseding diagnostics')
        dump(F/'retention-manifest.json',retention)
        files=[str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
        files += ['AGENTS.md','docs/MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.ja.md','docs/MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.md']
        assert 'skipped (' not in run('report-policy-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files])
        run('diff-check',['git','diff','--check'])
        assert all(m.sha(path)==sha for path,sha in originals.items())
        assert all(m.sha(row['path'])==row['sha256'] for row in deletions)
        for row in deletions:Path(row['path']).unlink()
        retention.update(deleted=True,removed_file_count=len(deletions),removed_logical_bytes=sum(row['bytes'] for row in deletions))
        dump(F/'retention-manifest.json',retention)
        run('stage',['git','add','--',str(F.relative_to(W)),'AGENTS.md','docs/MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.ja.md','docs/MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.md'])
        run('commit',['git','commit','-m','docs(bench): use upstream bench.sh and record qualified phase OFF control'])
        r['commit']=run('committed-head',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'])
        run('push',['git','push','-u','origin','feat/phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'])
        assert not run('final-status',['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True,complete=True,research_registry_count=922,summary=summary,
            removed_files=len(deletions),removed_logical_bytes=retention['removed_logical_bytes'])
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error']=repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed','error','commit','research_registry_count','removed_files')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
